title: Reinvent or Evolve? New Report Reveals the Two Paths to AI Success
summary: Concentrix commissions Everest Group to study driving AI value from transforming operating models, not simply automating work
body_markdown:
## *Concentrix commissions Everest Group to study driving AI value from transforming operating models, not simply automating work*


**NEWARK, Calif., (Sept. 17, 2026)** –[Concentrix Corporation](https://www.concentrix.com/news/) (NASDAQ:[CNXC](https://ir.concentrix.com/) ), a global technology and services leader, today announced findings of an independent market study, conducted by industry analyst firm, Everest Group. The report explores the operating models that successful businesses will use to orchestrate people, AI, data, and technology to deliver better business and customer outcomes.


[Reinvent or Evolve: Intelligent Operating Models Shaping AI-Enabled Customer Journeys](https://www.concentrix.com/insights/thought-leadership/reinvent-or-evolve-intelligent-operating-models-shaping-ai-enabled-customer-journeys/) , discusses that while many enterprises have adopted AI, most could achieve better outcomes by maximizing AI as a key enabler of a broader operating strategy.


This report demonstrates that organizations need to redesign their operating model purposely for AI, with two core paths to maximize competitive advantage: **Evolution** , where AI makes human-led operations smarter and more efficient through human & AI collaboration, and **Reinvention** , which sees a wholesale redesign around a native AI and agentic operating environment. Currently, only about 16% of enterprises expect AI to autonomously lead most customer interactions next year.


Based on research independently conducted across enterprise decision-makers, the report finds the biggest barrier to AI success isn’t the AI itself, it’s the ability to establish governance, and orchestrate execution across functions, technologies, and teams at scale.


“The conversation around AI often focuses on technology adoption, but the bigger challenge is operating model transformation,” said Sharang Sharma, Vice President, Everest Group. “As enterprises move toward AI-enabled customer journeys, they need partners that can create a clear framework for governance, accountability and execution. Success will depend less on deploying AI tools and more on creating the organizational readiness to scale them effectively across the business.”


“The biggest opportunity organizations have with AI isn’t to automate what’s already there. It’s to create entirely new ways of delivering value,” said Chris Caldwell, President & CEO of Concentrix. “The organizations seeing the strongest results are redesigning customer experiences, embedding AI into the flow of work, and combining human expertise with intelligent technology to achieve better business outcomes. That’s where the next generation of competitive advantage will emerge.”


The report found that organizations are moving beyond AI as a standalone tool, to reshaping customer experiences through operating model redesign. For example, a leading retailer was able to deliver responses 31% faster with Agentic AI, creating a scalable path to lower cost-to-serve.


As AI moves from experimentation to enterprise scale, businesses need partners that can orchestrate strategy, consulting, technology, and operations into a united ecosystem. Through its proprietary iX Suite, Concentrix helps clients unite people, technology, data, and operations to evolve existing journeys and enable AI-native experiences.


To learn more about the study and its findings, visit[Reinvent or Evolve: Intelligent Operating Models Shaping AI-Enabled Customer Journeys](https://www.concentrix.com/insights/thought-leadership/reinvent-or-evolve-intelligent-operating-models-shaping-ai-enabled-customer-journeys/) *.*
